findings.title: Hold-up after the PA6 trip is about a third of the quoted ride-through, and no record states the narrow window the PA6 trip voltage must sit in

records: docs/M3_R10.md Power 'Hold-up' and Firmware 'Ports and shedding': 0.464-0.539 ms (all ports, SD writing) and 1.304-1.412 ms (camera off, logic shed) at 300.8 uF
docs/REQUIREMENTS.md F6: the hold-up need is 'the time firmware needs after the PA6 watchdog fires'; 'If that is about 0.2 ms (Inference), 100-220 uF would do'
m3_design/assembly_review/sources/r10_design/parts_budget.json battery_break_ride_through_note: 'constant-power loads ... from 7.4 V' (the break, not the trip)

calculation.trip_window_upper_bound: lowest legitimate BAT_IN 5.37-5.54 V at four stalls plus a fire pulse (7.4 V EMF, 0.15 ohm source, 5.73 V four-stall point; shorted match 2.26-2.41 A, healthy match 1.24 A) -> VLOGIC about 5.25-5.45 V after U9 (<=45 mOhm) and U11 (<=0.1 Ohm)
calculation.trip_window_lower_bound: U9 turn-off corner 4.288-4.778 V BAT_IN (UVLO(F) 1.076-1.116 V, 1 % divider, +-0.1 uA EN leakage; SLVSFC9C p9): in a slow sag a trip below about 4.7 V VLOGIC comes after U9 has already cut the board
calculation.R19-REQ-07_capacitor_claim: from a 5.3 V trip with all ports on: 100 uF 0.052-0.061 ms, 220 uF 0.115-0.133 ms (both below the 0.2 ms example); from 7.4 V (the records' basis) 0.154-0.394 ms
calculation.label: Calculation (constant-power, the records' own load powers and capacitance); trip voltage itself not yet chosen

sources: docs/REQUIREMENTS.md F7 / Pack rows (7.4 V EMF, 0.15 ohm, 4.778 V corner)

findings.impact: The owner question R19-REQ-07 (how long the logic must stay up after PA6 fires, and whether C84 can shrink to 100-220 uF) is being answered against energy counted from 7.4 V, of which roughly two thirds is spent before PA6 can legitimately trip. A C84 reduction sized on the quoted figures would leave about 0.05-0.13 ms after the trip with ports on. No PA6 threshold is stated anywhere, and both window edges matter: too high and the four-stall/fire corner sheds logging at deployment; too low and a slow pack sag lets U9 cut the board before the shed starts. No pyro or deployment effect.
findings.concrete_fix: Text only. In M3_R10 Power 'Hold-up' / Firmware, REQUIREMENTS F6 and the R10_VALIDATION owner row for R19-REQ-07: (1) state the PA6 trip window, VLOGIC about 4.8-5.2 V (PA6 0.44-0.47 V), above U9's 4.78 V BAT_IN turn-off corner and below the 5.37 V BAT_IN four-stall-plus-fire corner, to be qualified with the divider and ADC tolerances; (2) quote hold-up from the trip voltage (300.8 uF: 0.157-0.182 ms all ports, 0.44-0.48 ms camera off / shed, from 5.3 V) beside the existing break-to-3.8 V figures; (3) strike or recompute '100-220 uF would do'. Add the trip-to-3.8 V case to parts_budget.json at the next generator run.

findings.title: The J400 chatter acceptance (longest drop-out < 10 ms) does not screen a chatter train: an open fraction above about 21-25 % at 5.73-6.0 V turns U9 off however short each drop-out is

records: docs/REQUIREMENTS.md F6 'Bench acceptance (proposed, R18-REQ-12): ... pass if the longest drop-out is < 10 ms'
docs/ORDERING.md 8.3 'Measure the chosen switch's contact chatter at flight vibration: pass if the longest drop-out is < 10 ms'

calculation.chatter_equilibrium: closed: C dV/dt = (Vb-V)/R_top - V/R81 - I_lk; open: C dV/dt = -V/R81 - I_lk; averaged over a train with open fraction d, EN settles at ((1-d)Vb/R_top - I_lk)/((1-d)/R_top + 1/R81), independent of C87
calculation.label: Calculation (TI SLVSFC9C p9 thresholds and +-0.1 uA leakage; 1 % resistors; C87 0.72-1.27 x as the records use); script .supervisor/r23_power/en_numerics.py

findings.impact: A loose or vibrating screw switch that chatters for tens of milliseconds with 3-5 ms drop-outs passes the stated bench criterion yet turns U9 off (UVLO, not latched): the primary computer resets in flight and restarts 30-129 ms plus boot later (Blue Jay unaffected). F6 forbids repeated resets from a single cause. Pending physical qualification, so Minor.
findings.concrete_fix: Text only (REQUIREMENTS F6, ORDERING 8.3, R10_VEHICLE_HANDOFF switch row): make the pass rule functional as well as per-drop-out: at the lowest loaded pack voltage (5.73-6.0 V) under flight-level vibration, U9 must stay on for the whole run (RAW_PROTECTED at TP81 never below about 5 V, or no reset in the log), and the measured open fraction over any 100 ms window must stay below 20 %. Keep the < 10 ms single-drop-out rule.

findings.title: round22_alternates.md: the TPS259470A persistent-short behaviour is partly wrong (current, logic reboot, C84, FLT) and omits U9 cycling to TSD every cycle

datasheet.retry: TSD 154 C, hysteresis 10 C (p10); 'remains off until it has cooled down by TSDHYS. Thereafter ... an additional delay of tRST' 110 ms (p11, p37-38 Table 7-2): confirmed
datasheet.foldback: 'The current limit threshold in the foldback region (0V < VOUT < VFB) is lower than the steady state current limit threshold (ILIM)' (p32 note 2), VFB 1.9 V (p10); no foldback value is given (Inference beyond that)
datasheet.start_up: 'Active current limiting ... is active during start-up ... without waiting for the ITIMER delay' (p33 note 3); retry is a dVdt-limited start-up (p34 Figure 7-11)
datasheet.hard_short: fast trip at 2 x ILIM or IFT 22.2 A within 500 ns, re-on after 30 us in current limit (p10-11, p34)
datasheet.time_to_TSD: Figure 6-36 / 6-37 (p18): about 0.3 ms at 36 W, about 8 ms at 10 W (read from the plot, Inference)
datasheet.thermal: RthJA 41.7 / 74.5 C/W, TJ recommended max 125 C (p8)
datasheet.flt: Table 7-3 p38: overtemperature FLT L, latched; reverse current FLT L

calculation.hard_short: RAW_PROTECTED held below VFB 1.9 V; U11 IN2 UVLO 2.5-2.8 V rising (SLVSEA3F p7) and AP63203 UVLO 3.30-3.70 V rising (DS41326 p5) are never reached, so the logic does not boot on any retry; R89 pulls BAT_FAULT_N to the dead 3V3, so FLT is unobservable (pack-only)
calculation.reboot_band_ohm_at_7.4V: about 0.77-2.1 Ohm (VOUT >= 3.75 V at ILIM 3.96-4.84 A, yet above the limit with a 0.5 A board load); even there U11 settling plus soft start (C85 470 nF, about 190 V/s, SLVSEA3F p13 Table 9-1 interpolated) must finish before TSD
calculation.pack_current: hard short: the foldback level (< ILIM, unspecified) for each heat pulse, plus a <= 500 ns spike at 2 x ILIM (8.9 A) or IFT; 3.96-4.84 A only for VOUT >= 1.9 V
calculation.C84_per_cycle: none for a hard short (U11 reverse blocking keeps C84 off RAW_PROTECTED); about 0.1 A (514 uF x about 190 V/s) only in the overload band
calculation.U9_temperature: junction reaches TSD 154 C on every cycle, about every 110 ms plus heat and cool time, for as long as J400 stays closed (470L: once); average dissipation 0.1 W (36 W, 0.3 ms pulses) to about 1.5 W (7 W, 30 ms pulses) depending on the unspecified foldback current (Inference)
calculation.label: Calculation from SLVSFC9C figures; foldback amplitude and plot readings are Inference

findings.impact: The owner is choosing between the 470L, 470A and 474L with this analysis. As written it says the pack sees about 4.4 A pulses and the MCU reboots every cycle with FLT pulsing; for a hard short the board simply stays dead while U9 thermally cycles at 154 C indefinitely and drains the pack with low-duty pulses. This is a defect in the analysis, not in the board (U9 as fitted is the 470L). No AGENTS section 2 property changes: the fire path stays on BAT_IN, and with no logic there is no fire.
findings.concrete_fix: Text only: correct round22_alternates.md section 1.3 and the matching ORDERING 8.1 option text to: hard short -> foldback-limited current below ILIM (value not given by TI), logic dead, FLT unobservable, U9 at TSD every cycle while J400 stays closed; resistive overload of about 0.8-2 Ohm -> possible reboot attempts. State that the 470A turns a pad short into a dead board that keeps heating U9 and slowly drains the pack until J400 is opened.

findings.title: BAT_FAULT_N (PA5, EXTI5) also goes low whenever U9 blocks reverse current, so it pulses on fast pack-side drops; the records describe PA5 only as a U9 fault

evidence.datasheet: SLVSFC9C Table 7-3 p38: 'Reverse Current ((VOUT - VIN) > VREVTH): Reverse Current Blocking, latched N, FLT L'; VREVTH -36.45...-22.3 mV, VFWDTH 83-125 mV (p10); tRCB 1 us, tSWRCB 50 us (p11). UVLO and OVLO give FLT H (p38).
evidence.board: U9.4 B(18.5,81.6) -> BAT_FAULT_N -> R89.2 F(23.0,70.0) 10 kOhm to 3V3 -> U1.29 (PA5); pin_table.tsv row PA5: 'R89 10k to 3V3: high (no fault)'; REQUIREMENTS F10: 'EXTI ... 5 BAT fault PA5'
evidence.calculation: RAW_PROTECTED (67 uF nominal) unloaded by U9 falls at its own load slope, about 15-30 V/ms at 1-2 A; any BAT_IN drop faster than that reverses current through U9's 28-45 mOhm and trips RCB, e.g. a pack-connector or J1 contact bounce, a servo-driver current edge on a stiff pack, or a hot-plug transient; FLT stays low until VIN - VOUT > 83-125 mV (Calculation/Inference; slower drops such as a servo stall rise or the fire-pulse onset at 4-12 V/ms probably do not trip it)
evidence.U11_ST: TPS2121 ST is defined only for source selection (SLVSEA3F Table 9-3 p18); its state during U11's own reverse blocking (IRCB 0.2-2 A, p8, p15) is not stated: PA4 may also glitch during hold-up (Inference)

findings.impact: Firmware written from the records would read a short PA5 low as a U9 fault: a nuisance ground refusal or a spurious fault log in flight, or an EXTI5 interrupt storm under contact chatter. Conversely the same edge is a free, fast battery-break indicator the shedding logic does not use. No hardware or pyro effect.
findings.concrete_fix: Text only: in pin_table.tsv (PA5 note), the binding-note obligations and M3_R10 Firmware: 'PA5 low also means U9 is blocking reverse current (pack side below RAW_PROTECTED; SLVSFC9C Table 7-3 p38). Treat PA5 as a U9 fault only when it stays low longer than a qualified time with RAW_PROTECTED collapsed; rate-limit EXTI5; never reset or refuse readiness on a single pulse. Optionally use the PA5 falling edge to start the PA6 shed early.' Add that U11's ST during its own reverse blocking is unstated (Inference): deglitch PA4 before re-enabling the port UARTs.

fix_verification.claim: The TPS2553 grounds, CC Rd returns and power-state monitors are single-open taps: 33 taps, 15 exact exceptions
fix_verification.measurement: check_r10.single_via_opens run read-only on the board: 33 taps, 15 exceptions, 0 issues; single points U10.2 / R7.2 / R85.2 via GND (9.00,27.84), U402.2 / R430.2 via GND (32.30,59.50), R8.2 via GND (9.95,30.60), R60.1 via VLOGIC (34.50,63.00), U1.28 via (30.85,51.80), R91.1 via 3V3 (28.10,60.00). Own fill-piece survey: U10.2 + R7.2 B.Cu island 2.89 mm2 / 1 via; U402.2 5.70 mm2 / 1 via; R8.2 6.96 mm2 / 1 via; U10.2 has no track, only the island. No existing tap or exception was removed (diff). Open-GND consequence (Inference, SLVS841G is silent; GND pin p4, abs max p5, UVLO 2.35-2.45 V p7): the IC's quiescent current can return only through its pin protection to the lowest pin, so its ground floats to about one diode above OUT; IN-GND then approaches UVLO and OUT limps at roughly 2-3 V or cycles, i.e. camera (U402) or bench-USB (U10) supply loss, as the record says. Two refinements: FAULT is an open drain to that floating ground, so CAM_FAULT_N / USB_FAULT_N cannot report it (CAM_5V_SENSE on PB1 can, nothing senses USB_LIMITED); and R85 / R430 return to board ground while the IC ground floats, so the current limit is no longer referenced as designed (with a coincident camera-lead short it could sit above 1.07-1.22 A: Inference, double fault)
fix_verification.verdict: confirmed (reasons consistent; the FAULT-flag limitation could be added to the reason text)

rejected_or_closed_candidates.item: Brown-out order as RAW falls (slow sag, J400 closed)
rejected_or_closed_candidates.result: PORT_5V3 leaves regulation first (RAW about 5.77 V camera on / 5.57 V camera off: 5.456 V + I x (0.125 Ohm typ RDS(on)1, DS41326 p5, + 0.0762 Ohm SRP5030T-6R8M DCR)); PORT_4V8 next (RAW about 5.31 / 5.10 V: + 0.200 V TPS7A91 dropout max at 1 A, SBVS282A p5); then U9 cuts the whole board at its UVLO corner, BAT_IN 4.29-4.78 V, while 3V3 is still regulated (U2 needs VLOGIC >= about 3.4 V); in hold-up the ports collapse (with or without U11's reverse blocking, IRCB 0.2-2 A, SLVSEA3F p8), then 3V3 below VLOGIC about 3.4 V and AP63203 UVLO 2.86-3.26 V (3.30-3.70 rising, 440 mV hysteresis typ, DS41326 p5; 'below 3.1 V disabled' p11), then the MCU at BOR (VBOR0 falling 1.58-1.68 V, VBOR1 1.95-2.06 V, DS12110 Rev 8 Table 126). At the four-stall corner (BAT_IN 5.73 V) only PORT_5V3 with the camera on leaves regulation, by about 0.13 V. Calculation; no defect beyond R23-POWER-01

Above BOR the pins are driven to their ODR; below BOR the MCU is in reset with pins in their reset state and the external pull-downs hold them: R123 2 kOhm on ACT_EN, R127 1 kOhm on the PE4 node, R128 10 kOhm and C126 220 nF on PYRO1_GATE. Defined at every VDD. The bus (RAW_ACT) can stay on 39-85 ms after Q122 turns off (C120 time constant), by design; firing still needs PE4. Calculation

rejected_or_closed_candidates.item: Fire pulse into R134 and its tail
rejected_or_closed_candidates.result: Q124 off-tail after a commanded PE4 low 0.05-0.10 ms (220 Ohm x 222 nF to Vth 1.2-0.4 V, AON7524 p2); after a reset (PE4 Hi-Z, 1.087 kOhm) 0.24-0.50 ms, inside the 1.5 ms allocation of the 34.853 ms guard. Drain dV/dt kick into the gate about 8 mV (C126 dominates). Shorted match 35.8 W in R134 against about 46 W at 36 ms and 63 W at 20 ms read from the Bourns CRM2512 >= 1 Ohm pulse curve (p3; reading is Inference): 1.29x / 1.75x. Four stalls plus a shorted match leave BAT_IN about 5.37 V, above U9's 4.78 V corner. Calculation; no defect

rejected_or_closed_candidates.item: USB plug / unplug with the pack on
rejected_or_closed_candidates.result: U11 in VCOMP mode (PR1, CP2, OV2 grounded; OV1 = USB_OVLO 47k/10k -> 5.76-6.27 V) keeps IN2 while the pack exceeds USB_LIMITED; plug-in only re-runs the settling timer (SLVSEA3F p12, Table 9-3 p18). rejected_or_closed_candidates.item: Port device hot-plug (J410 / J420 / J440 / J9)
rejected_or_closed_candidates.result: Charge sharing on PORT_4V8 (about 95 uF effective, Inference): a 10 / 22 / 47 / 100 uF module input dips the shared rail to 4.34 / 3.89 / 3.21 / 2.33 V for 0.05-0.51 ms (TPS7A91 limit 1.5-1.9 A, SBVS282A p5), enough to reset the radio on another port; J9 is behind U402's 1.07-1.22 A limit.
